item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.10)] CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks Are Soaring, but Is the Rally Already Priced In?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.10)
CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Palo Alto Networks (PANW) have both seen their stock prices roughly double this year, with a recent rally fueled by AI safety concerns shifting investor focus to cybersecurity. While both companies show strong fundamentals and bullish analyst sentiment, CrowdStrike's stock is currently trading above its analyst consensus target, suggesting its growth may already be priced in. Palo Alto Networks, however, still has upside to its consensus target, with its Next-Generation Security ARR growth providing a stronger foundation for its current multiple.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.15)] Jamie Dimon was fired from Citigroup at 42 — he turned a $20 billion bank into America's most profitable
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.15)
Jamie Dimon, CEO of JPMorgan Chase, was fired from Citigroup at age 42. Despite this setback, he went on to lead Bank One, investing $60 million of his own money, and later became CEO of JPMorgan Chase, transforming it into America's most profitable bank. In July, JPMorgan Chase posted the highest quarterly profit ever by a U.S. bank at $21.2 billion.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13), NVDA Neutral (+0.12)] Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) Caps Xbox Cloud Gaming Hours For Game Pass Subscribers Starting November
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.13), NVDA Neutral (+0.12)
Microsoft is implementing monthly time limits for Xbox Cloud Gaming for Game Pass subscribers starting in November, ending unlimited streaming access. Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, and Essential subscribers will face caps of 15, 10, and 5 hours respectively, with options to purchase additional hours. This strategic shift aims to improve the gaming division's financial performance and control rising infrastructure costs, though it risks pushing heavy streamers to rival services like Nvidia’s GeForce Now.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.03)] Exploring The Competitive Space: NVIDIA Versus Industry Peers In Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equip
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.03)
This article analyzes NVIDIA (NVDA) against its competitors in the Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment industry, focusing on financial metrics, market position, and growth potential. NVIDIA shows signs of undervaluation with a P/E ratio below the industry average, yet boasts strong profitability and operational efficiency as indicated by high ROE, EBITDA, gross profit, and revenue growth. The company also demonstrates a robust financial position with a lower debt-to-equity ratio compared to its peers.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.39)] Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Tempus, Moderna, Super Micro Computer and Aya Gold & Silver
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.39)
Zacks Investment Ideas highlights several stocks including NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Moderna, Super Micro Computer, and Aya Gold & Silver, noting their resilience despite market uncertainties in 2026. The article argues that while macroeconomic and geopolitical factors have caused fear, investor sentiment is overly negative, and historical data suggests potential for a strong market rally into year-end, especially for AI-related stocks. It emphasizes focusing on price action over news headlines and refutes overblown AI safety concerns.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.53)] Licensable picture: Apple Launches New IPhone 18 In Thailand.

This launch is anticipated to significantly boost smartphone sales in Thailand during the final quarter of 2026. The devices were displayed at an Apple Store in Bangkok.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.12)] Enovix reaffirms Q3 guidance, details $552M balance sheet amid CEO transition
item.description:

Enovix Corporation reaffirmed its Q3 2026 financial guidance and detailed a strong $552.1 million cash balance during an investor webcast following its CEO's resignation. Ryan Benton was appointed Interim CEO, and the company emphasized operational continuity with key executive leadership. Enovix also highlighted progress in smartphone battery cycle-life testing and a growing pipeline in defense and drone applications.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.28)] F5 and Omnissa Partner to Secure Digital Workspaces
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.28)
F5 and Omnissa have announced a strategic partnership to enhance the security, resilience, and scalability of virtual desktop and application delivery architectures for enterprises. This collaboration integrates F5's advanced application delivery and Zero Trust security capabilities with Omnissa's digital workspace portfolio. The joint solution aims to consolidate DMZ architectures, automate multi-site failover, and provide secure access for distributed workforces, supported by channel partners like Presidio.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] An undisclosed Microsoft presentation is now central to a multi-million dollar antitrust fight
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02)
A new court order from the UK Competition Appeal Tribunal is demanding documents from Microsoft executives regarding a £270 million (about $361 million) antitrust lawsuit filed by ValueLicensing, a secondhand software reseller. The case centers on allegations that Microsoft used licensing restrictions and discounts to push customers from perpetual software to subscription services, suppressing the resale market for pre-owned licenses, which is legal under EU law. A previously undisclosed "Second-Hand Software" presentation is now a key piece of evidence, and Microsoft must explain its late disclosure and provide other relevant communications.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.43)] Huang says Nvidia’s chip sales will double next year
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.43)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced that the company expects to double its chip sales next year, citing the significant contributions of AI to various industries and economies. This projection comes after Nvidia forecast 70% growth in the fiscal year ending January 2028, reaching approximately $673 billion. Huang made these remarks at a summit with King Charles III in Scotland, where he also discussed AI safety alongside other tech leaders.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02), NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Microsoft (MSFT) Puts a Clock on Free Xbox Cloud Gaming
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02), NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
Microsoft is implementing monthly time limits on free Xbox Cloud Gaming for Game Pass subscribers starting in November, a change aimed at improving the economics of the service. While this affects only about 4% of heavy users, it could lead to increased churn or prompt users to switch to competing services like Nvidia's GeForce Now. The move reflects Microsoft's effort to align revenue with computing resources consumed and prioritize profitability in its gaming division.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] Prediction: A $5,000 Investment Split Between Micron and Sandisk Will Triple Before 2028
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.32)
An analysis suggests that a $5,000 investment split between Micron and Sandisk could triple before 2028, driven by massive demand for memory chips due to the growth in artificial intelligence. Both companies are experiencing significant revenue growth, and despite their strong performance in 2026, their stocks are trading at attractive valuations compared to historical levels. The author believes analysts may be underestimating their potential for 2027.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.15), NVDA Neutral (-0.11)] $500,000 Split Between VOO and QQQ Owns the Same Seven Stocks Twice, and Nobody Adds Up the Overlap
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.15), NVDA Neutral (-0.11)
Investing a combined $500,000 into popular ETFs VOO and QQQ results in significant overlap, with approximately $167,000 concentrated in the same seven mega-cap stocks. This apparent diversification actually leads to duplication and higher fees, as QQQ's expense ratio is six times that of VOO. The article suggests replacing QQQ with lower-cost alternatives like QQQM or SPLG to maintain exposure while reducing redundant costs.

item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.24)] Walmart is accelerating its battle against Amazon with a weapon that the e-commerce giant cannot copy: more than 4,000 stores
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bearish (-0.24)
Walmart is leveraging its extensive network of over 4,000 physical stores to compete with Amazon, transforming them into distribution and delivery centers for its rapidly growing e-commerce business. This strategy has resulted in a 23% increase in global e-commerce sales, with stores fulfilling a significant portion of online orders and accelerating delivery times. Walmart's approach integrates physical and digital operations, aiming to use its brick-and-mortar presence as a key advantage in the e-commerce landscape.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.42)] Apple (AAPL) Outperforms Broader Market: What You Need to Know
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.42)
Apple (AAPL) demonstrated strong performance in its latest trading session, closing up 1.47% and outperforming the broader S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq indices. The company's stock has also seen significant gains over the past month, exceeding its sector and the S&P 500. Analysts anticipate strong earnings and revenue growth for Apple's upcoming disclosure, holding a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.29)] Insider Selling: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) EVP Sells 17,261 Shares
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.29)
Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) EVP Forrest Norrod sold 17,261 shares of the company's stock for approximately $8.68 million, reducing his holdings by 4.54%. This transaction was conducted under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite competitive risks and a high valuation, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for AMD, which recently reported better-than-expected quarterly results and shows strong year-over-year revenue growth.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.24)] Amazon Says AI Models Should Be Released When ‘Ready and Safe’
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.24)
Amazon believes that artificial intelligence models should be released only after thorough testing to ensure they are "ready and safe to use." This stance comes amid calls from other AI leaders for a slower pace of development due to safety concerns. Amazon, an investor in leading AI companies and a developer of its own models, emphasizes the importance of industry collaboration with government to establish necessary protections.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.41)] Nvidia, Google and Emerald AI launch flexible data center consortium
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.41)
Nvidia, Google, and Emerald AI have formed the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA) to promote and standardize flexible data centers. These facilities can reduce their power consumption during peak demand or even feed power back into the grid using on-site batteries, optimizing energy usage and supporting grid stability. AEMA's initial focus will be on developing best practices and standard metrics for these flexible data centers.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.04), AMZN Bullish (+0.29)] AI Security Debate — Amazon Says AI Models To Be Released Only When 'Ready And Safe'
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.04), AMZN Bullish (+0.29)
Amazon has stated that artificial intelligence models should only be released after extensive vetting and safety checks, advocating for collaboration between tech leaders and government bodies to manage deployment risks. This stance aligns Amazon with partners like OpenAI and Anthropic, amidst a growing Silicon Valley debate on government-mandated AI safeguards. The company emphasizes that consumer security should not be compromised for technological advancement and that releasing unverified models creates systemic market risks.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] Ross Stores Announces Changes to Board of Directors
item.description:

Ross Stores, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROST) has announced changes to its Board of Directors, effective October 1, 2026. Shelley H. Bransten and Christian B. Johnson will join the Board, bringing extensive experience in technology, retail, consumer industries, and investment in consumer-facing businesses. Sharon D. Garrett will retire from the Board after 25 years of service.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.40)] Microsoft tests post-quantum interoperability
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.40)
Microsoft is testing post-quantum cryptography interoperability with certificate authorities like DigiCert to ensure practical and deployable solutions for the quantum era. The company emphasizes starting with real customer problems and building solutions that work across existing infrastructure rather than focusing solely on cryptographic novelty. This controlled testing environment helps identify and resolve compatibility issues early, making the transition to post-quantum cryptography more seamless for customers.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.35)] Why Investors May Want to Buy Procter & Gamble if Consumer Spending Cools
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.35)
As consumer confidence declines, investors may seek resilient stocks. Procter & Gamble (PG) is presented as a strong candidate due to its 70-year history of dividend increases, well-funded dividends, and diversified portfolio of essential consumer staples. Its current stock price is down from its 52-week high, making its dividend yield attractive for income-oriented investors.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.23)] Bond Draws Over a Thousand Security Leaders to Its Booth at Global Security Exchange 2026 as Investments in Growth Begin to Take Hold
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.23)
Bond, Inc. reported strong engagement at Global Security Exchange (GSX) 2026, where over a thousand security leaders visited its booth, leading to more than 50 new enterprise and government opportunities. The company showcased its AI-powered Preventative Personal Security platform and highlighted an EY ROI report indicating significant cost savings for corporations. Bond also co-sponsored the Women in Security and NextGen Awards with Amazon, demonstrating its commitment to growth and market expansion.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.19), AMZN Bullish (+0.30)] Wells Fargo sees 50% upside for Amazon-linked stock
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.19), AMZN Bullish (+0.30)
Wells Fargo has initiated coverage on Cipher Digital (Nasdaq: CIFR) with an "overweight" rating and a $25 price target, suggesting a 50% upside. The company, formerly a Bitcoin miner, has pivoted to AI operations, securing significant deals with Amazon Web Services and Fluidstack (backed by Google). Wells Fargo considers Cipher Digital a high-risk, high-reward investment, with its AI deals contributing substantially to its valuation.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.55)] Want AI to Actually Help Your Company Make Money? Follow These 5 Tips From Microsoft’s Playbook
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.55)
Microsoft has released its Frontier Playbook, offering guidance for companies looking to move beyond AI experiments and achieve concrete business results. The playbook, based on over 100 internal AI projects at Microsoft, emphasizes that AI adoption is a "business transformation" requiring clear outcome goals. It highlights five key takeaways, including the importance of setting specific business objectives rather than just deploying AI tools, and assigning executive ownership for those goals.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.40)] Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.40)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced that the company expects to double its chip sales next year, driven by the significant contributions of AI across various industries and economies. This forecast follows the company's recent projection of 70% growth for the fiscal year ending in January 2028. Huang also discussed AI safety during a summit with King Charles III, emphasizing the importance of engineering safe products.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.13)] Hour Loop Falls 22% in Three Months: Should You Buy the Dip or Wait?
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.13)
Hour Loop (HOUR) shares have dropped 22% in the last three months, underperforming the industry and broader market, primarily due to heavy reliance on Amazon, rising fulfillment costs, and liquidity issues. Despite these challenges, the company is experiencing strong revenue growth, benefiting from a technology-enabled platform, and its stock is currently trading at a discount, suggesting a potential buying opportunity for investors.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.32)] Qualcomm Inc Stock (QCOM) Moved Up by 3.33% on Sep 17: What Investors Need To Know
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.32)
Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) saw its stock price rise by 3.33% on September 17, driven by a strong technology sector and its strategic partnership with Amazon Web Services to develop AI silicon for data centers. The company's diversification into AI and automotive electronics, combined with attractive valuation and a stable balance sheet, contributed to investor confidence despite potential challenges from Apple's in-house modem shift and competition in the AI market. Technical indicators show a buy signal, though the stock is nearing overbought conditions.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] MediaTek Stock Surpasses Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) In Market Cap As Dimensity 9600 Pro Targets Premium Smartphone Turf
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
MediaTek's market capitalization has surpassed Qualcomm's, with MediaTek reaching $223 billion compared to Qualcomm's $200.6 billion. This lead is further extended by MediaTek's new Dimensity 9600 Pro processor, built on TSMC's 2-nanometer process, which targets the premium smartphone market at a more competitive price. The article highlights how investor focus has shifted towards AI infrastructure partnerships, as demonstrated by Nvidia's $3.5 billion investment in MediaTek, rather than solely on handset market share battles.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.13)] Costco Expands U.S. E-Commerce With Nationwide DoorDash Launch
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
Costco Wholesale Corp. has expanded its e-commerce presence in the U.S. by launching on the DoorDash Marketplace, allowing members to order from all U.S. warehouses for same-day delivery. This nationwide rollout follows a successful international partnership and complements Costco's recent expansion of delivery services through Uber Eats. The move significantly increases DoorDash's reach among major food retailers, as Costco was a highly requested addition to its platform.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] Apple (AAPL) Faces a $2.7 Billion UK Lawsuit over its App Tracking Rules
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14)
Apple Inc. is facing a £2 billion ($2.7 billion) lawsuit in the UK over its App Tracking Transparency feature, which app developers allege unfairly favors Apple's own advertising services. This legal challenge is part of a broader pattern of European regulatory scrutiny on Apple's tracking practices, with similar actions in France, Italy, and Germany. Despite Apple's strong financial position to absorb potential legal costs, the lawsuit could force the company to make significant changes to its platform and advertising policies, potentially setting a precedent for its control over the app ecosystem.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.15)] IonQ Climbs 9% on Quantum Optimization Work With NVIDIA; D-Wave Rises 8%, Rigetti Gains 7%
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.15)
IonQ surged 9% due to research showing its quantum circuit generation time remains constant as problem sizes scale, a collaboration with NVIDIA, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, and the University of Tennessee. This news also caused other quantum computing stocks like D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Quantum Computing Inc. to rise in sympathy. However, the modest 2% gain of the Defiance Quantum ETF suggests that this is more of a speculative bet on IonQ's specific story rather than a broad re-pricing of the quantum computing industry, and investors should watch if this research translates into paying customers.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.21)] Chief Risk Officer Trims Holdings of Fintech Stock, Sells 2,097 Shares for $110,428
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.21)
PayPal's Chief Risk Officer, Aaron Webster, sold 2,097 shares for $110,428 as a non-discretionary tax withholding event following restricted stock unit vesting. Despite the sale, his direct equity holdings in PayPal increased. The article also notes PayPal's significant stock underperformance compared to the S&P 500 since 2021, yet highlights its solid fundamentals and more attractive valuation now.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Generac Surges 16% on $2.4B Amazon Data Center Generator Deal; Caterpillar Ticks Up, Cummins Sits Out the Rally
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
Generac (NYSE:GNRC) stock surged 16% following a $2.4 billion agreement to supply generators for Amazon's hyperscale data centers. While the deal rebrands Generac as a data center infrastructure supplier, the warrant arrangement giving Amazon equity in Generac introduces potential dilution that the market will need to price in. Competitors like Cummins (NYSE:CMI) remained flat, and Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) saw only a modest 2% gain, indicating that Generac's rally is a company-specific event rather than a sector-wide repricing of backup power solutions.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.47)] Latest Microsoft Defender email security benchmarking insights | Microsoft Security Blog
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.47)
Microsoft has published its latest email security benchmarking report, highlighting Microsoft Defender's strong performance in protecting against high-severity email threats. The report shows that Defender missed significantly fewer threats compared to other secure email gateway vendors and details how continuous measurement informs product improvements in prevention, detection, and adaptation. Key innovations include more control over promotional mail, a redesigned AI model stack for improved detection accuracy, and prompt injection protection for AI systems.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.05), NVDA Bearish (-0.23)] Nvidia Is an ‘Awesome Company,’ but Its Stock Is Priced as ‘Greatest Company Ever,’ Damodaran Says
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.05), NVDA Bearish (-0.23)
NYU Stern finance professor Aswath Damodaran views Nvidia as an "awesome company" but believes its stock valuation, exceeding $5 trillion, is priced as the "greatest company ever." He suggests that the current AI sector revenue and investment would require annual revenues of $8 trillion to $10 trillion to justify the infrastructure buildout, far beyond today's $250 billion. Damodaran posits that such growth is only achievable if AI replaces workers rather than merely augmenting productivity, which would then pose new economic challenges regarding consumer spending.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.53)] Siemens and Procter & Gamble roll out AI-based quality inspection worldwide
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.53)
Siemens and Procter & Gamble (P&G) are expanding the global deployment of an AI-based quality inspection solution across P&G's manufacturing operations. This system, called Visual Inspection Cockpit (VIC), inspects products in real time, reducing scrap rates by 10-20% and commissioning new deployments 5-10 times faster than traditional systems. The solution combines P&G's deep learning models with Siemens' Industrial Edge computing platform, leveraging Industrial AI to adapt to variations in production and improve product quality.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.14), MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] OpenAI Fires Back at Apple (AAPL)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.14), MSFT Neutral (+0.13)
OpenAI has denied Apple's allegations of trade secret theft in a recent court filing, labeling the dispute a "mess of Apple's own making" and asserting employees' right to free movement between employers. This legal battle arises as OpenAI recruits former Apple employees for its hardware initiatives, while Apple diversifies its AI partnerships beyond OpenAI. The article analyzes the bull and bear cases for Apple, highlighting the impact of talent loss and potential competitive threats from OpenAI's expansion into consumer hardware.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.43)] Microsoft releases new AI playbook for enterprises with real-world examples, and it reveals a surprising 'moat' you may already have
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.43)
Microsoft has released a 44-page "Frontier Playbook" for enterprises, based on its own extensive internal AI transformation efforts. The company advises against simply deploying AI tools into existing workflows, suggesting instead that organizations should first redesign processes and establish a shared data foundation. Microsoft emphasizes that durable competitive advantage in AI will come from proprietary evaluations, context, and orchestration rather than reliance on interchangeable foundation models.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Generac Signs Amazon Generator Deal With $2.4B of Initial Deliveries
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Generac Holdings Inc. has secured a significant long-term supply agreement with Amazon, providing backup power generators for Amazon's data centers with initial deliveries valued at $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. This deal solidifies Generac's position in the rapidly growing data center infrastructure market, with the potential for up to $8 billion in qualifying payments and causing Generac's shares to rise significantly in premarket trading. The company is also expanding its production capacity and facing increasing competition from companies like Cummins and Caterpillar in the data center power sector.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31)] B Riley initiates coverage of Nokia with a buy rating and a $15 price target - BN
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.31)
B Riley Securities has initiated coverage of Nokia with a "buy" rating and a $15 price target, as reported by Bloomberg News. The research firm believes the market is underestimating Nokia's potential growth from AI and a shift to fast-growing core network architecture. They also highlighted Nokia's rising gross margins, strong cash flow, and attractive valuation.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Why Generac Shares Are Trading Higher By Around 35%; Here Are 20 Stocks Moving Premarket
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE: GNRC) shares surged by about 35% in pre-market trading following the announcement of a long-term supply agreement with Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) for data center backup generators, valued at up to $8 billion. This agreement projects initial deliveries of $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. The article also lists other stocks experiencing significant pre-market movements, both gainers and losers, due to various company-specific news and financial updates.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.48)] Microsoft, Marvell and Utimaco to Deliver Industry-first Secure, Cloud-scale Payments Solution
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.00)] Why Taiwan’s Silicon Shield Is Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.00)
Taiwan's "silicon shield," stemming from its dominance in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, is facing challenges as China invests heavily in chip self-reliance, particularly in mature-node chips. While Taiwan still holds leverage in cutting-edge chips, China's increasing capacity in 28-nanometer chips threatens to make Taiwan's shield irrelevant for its own economy, potentially leading to a more fragile global trade environment with rising chip prices. This shift means that the geopolitical importance of Taiwan's chip production will no longer solely rely on the most advanced technologies, but also on the control of common chip manufacturing.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.01)] Where Does AMD Make Its Processors?
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.01)
AMD processors are primarily manufactured in Taiwan by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), the world's largest semiconductor producer. While TSMC has facilities in Arizona for some AI chips, the final assembly and packaging of AMD CPUs occur in places like Penang, Malaysia, and China. This manufacturing strategy is similar to Nvidia's, with TSMC also producing chips for other major tech companies like Apple and Tesla.
